steps.title: Mechanical and safety preflight
steps.summary: Square the gantry where applicable, tighten hardware, verify clean motion components, correct thermistors, a clean nozzle, and a hot-tightened leak-free hotend.

steps.title: Capture a known-good baseline
steps.summary: Import the working configuration or capture the live Klipper configuration before changes.

steps.title: Calibrate extruder rotation distance
steps.summary: Command a known filament length, measure actual movement, calculate rotation_distance, repeat, and only then save.

steps.title: Prepare the build surface
steps.summary: Confirm the correct plate, cleaning method, material temperature, and adhesion condition.

steps.title: Tune first-layer squish
steps.summary: Complete rough Z calibration, print a suitable patch, live-adjust the first layer, then save the verified offset.

steps.title: Tune pressure advance
steps.summary: Run the appropriate pressure-advance pattern after extruder calibration and record the filament-specific value.

steps.title: Tune extrusion multiplier
steps.summary: Use a controlled print and visual surface evaluation; store the result with the filament profile rather than as universal hardware truth.

steps.title: Tune cooling and layer time
steps.summary: Choose stable fan behaviour and minimum layer time for the material and enclosure conditions.

steps.title: Tune retraction only after pressure advance
steps.summary: Start conservatively, look for other causes of stringing, and avoid excessive direct-drive retraction.

steps.title: Tune infill/perimeter overlap and stepover
steps.summary: Finish slicer-specific overlap and top-surface settings after flow is stable.

steps.title: Optional advanced limits
steps.summary: Determine maximum volumetric flow, safe motor currents, speeds, and accelerations; use production values below synthetic limits.

steps.title: Progressive endurance verification
steps.summary: Pass a short calibration print, a medium print, and a representative endurance print before trusting a 36-hour job.
